title: 1967 AHSME Problem 19
statement: The area of a rectangle remains unchanged when it is made \(2\dfrac12\) inches longer and \(\dfrac23\) inch narrower, or when it is made \(2\dfrac12\) inches shorter and \(\dfrac43\) inch wider. Its area, in square inches, is:

solutions.text:
The two conditions are \[ \begin{aligned} lw&=\left(l+\frac52\right)\left(w-\frac23\right),\\ lw&=\left(l-\frac52\right)\left(w+\frac43\right). \end{aligned} \] After expanding, these give \(-4l+15w=10\) and \(8l-15w=20.\) Hence \(l=\frac{15}{2},\) \(w=\frac{8}{3},\) and \(lw=20.\)

Therefore, the correct answer is E.
hints: Let the original length and width be \(l\) and \(w\)
Expand both equal-area equations; the \(lw\) terms cancel
